name: location_org_unit_link
description: GH #3586 / REQ-644, decisions 0050 D3.6, 0051 D6, 0066 and 0067. One row says that an organization unit works with a location; the relation is many to many (one location with several units, one unit with several locations). location_id is the record_id of a location_node; the foreign_keys entry fk_location_org_unit_link_location_id promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT. org_unit_id is the record_id of an org_unit of module org; it is another pack, so it has no foreign key and the reads check it. The pair is unique (uq_location_org_unit_link). idx_location_org_unit_link_org_unit_id indexes the scope column. active false retires the link. Nothing writes these rows yet; the writer is a later step.
